## Example Usage - Saas Runtime Flag Basic


```hcl
resource "google_saas_runtime_saas" "example_saas" {
  provider = google-nightly
  saas_id  = "example-saas"
  location = "global"

  locations {
    name = "us-central1"
  }
}

resource "google_saas_runtime_unit_kind" "example_unit_kind" {
  provider     = google-nightly
  location     = "global"
  unit_kind_id = "example-unit-kind"
  saas         = google_saas_runtime_saas.example_saas.id
}

resource "google_saas_runtime_flag" "example" {
  provider        = google-nightly
  location        = "global"
  flag_id         = "example-flag"
  key             = "example-flag-key"
  flag_value_type = "FLAG_VALUE_TYPE_BOOLEAN"
  unit_kind       = google_saas_runtime_unit_kind.example_unit_kind.id

  variants {
    id            = "enabled"
    boolean_value = true
  }

  variants {
    id            = "disabled"
    boolean_value = false
  }

  evaluation_spec {
    default_variant = "disabled"
  }
}
```

## Example Usage - Saas Runtime Flag Full


```hcl
resource "google_saas_runtime_saas" "example_saas" {
  provider = google-nightly
  saas_id  = "example-saas-full"
  location = "global"

  locations {
    name = "us-central1"
  }
}

resource "google_saas_runtime_unit_kind" "example_unit_kind" {
  provider     = google-nightly
  location     = "global"
  unit_kind_id = "example-unit-kind-full"
  saas         = google_saas_runtime_saas.example_saas.id
}

resource "google_saas_runtime_flag_attribute" "tier_attribute" {
  provider             = google-nightly
  location             = "global"
  flag_attribute_id    = "tier-attr"
  key                  = "app_tier"
  attribute_value_type = "FLAG_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_TYPE_STRING"
}

resource "google_saas_runtime_flag_attribute" "user_attribute" {
  provider             = google-nightly
  location             = "global"
  flag_attribute_id    = "user-attr"
  key                  = "user_id"
  attribute_value_type = "FLAG_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_TYPE_STRING"
}

resource "google_saas_runtime_flag" "example" {
  provider        = google-nightly
  location        = "global"
  flag_id         = "example-flag-full"
  key             = "example-flag-full-key"
  flag_value_type = "FLAG_VALUE_TYPE_BOOLEAN"
  unit_kind       = google_saas_runtime_unit_kind.example_unit_kind.id
  description     = "Initial feature flag description"
  flag_set        = "checkout-flags"
  state           = "FLAG_STATE_IN_DEVELOPMENT"

  variants {
    id            = "disabled"
    description   = "Disabled variant"
    boolean_value = false
  }

  variants {
    id            = "enabled"
    description   = "Enabled variant"
    boolean_value = true
  }

  evaluation_spec {
    attributes = [
      google_saas_runtime_flag_attribute.tier_attribute.id,
      google_saas_runtime_flag_attribute.user_attribute.id,
    ]
    default_allocation = "rollout-alloc"

    allocations {
      id            = "rollout-alloc"
      randomized_on = google_saas_runtime_flag_attribute.user_attribute.key
      description   = "Initial rollout split"

      slots {
        variant = "disabled"
        weight  = 80
      }

      slots {
        variant = "enabled"
        weight  = 20
      }
    }

    dynamic_allocations {
      id              = "gradual-rollout"
      randomized_on   = google_saas_runtime_flag_attribute.user_attribute.key
      description     = "Gradual rollout template"
      initial_variant = "disabled"
      final_variant   = "enabled"
      salt            = "custom-rollout-salt"
    }

    rules {
      id         = "enterprise-rule"
      condition  = "${google_saas_runtime_flag_attribute.tier_attribute.key} == 'enterprise'"
      variant_id = "enabled"
    }

    rules {
      id            = "beta-rule"
      condition     = "${google_saas_runtime_flag_attribute.tier_attribute.key} == 'beta'"
      allocation_id = "rollout-alloc"
    }

    rules {
      id                    = "preview-rule"
      condition             = "${google_saas_runtime_flag_attribute.tier_attribute.key} == 'preview'"
      dynamic_allocation_id = "gradual-rollout"
    }
  }

  labels = {
    "label-one" = "foo"
  }

  annotations = {
    "annotation-one" = "bar"
  }
}
```

## Example Usage - Saas Runtime Flag Variants


```hcl
resource "google_saas_runtime_saas" "example_saas" {
  provider = google-nightly
  saas_id  = "example-saas-variants"
  location = "global"

    name = "us-central1"
  }
}

resource "google_saas_runtime_unit_kind" "example_unit_kind" {
  provider     = google-nightly
  location     = "global"
  unit_kind_id = "example-unit-kind-variants"

}

resource "google_saas_runtime_flag_attribute" "user_attribute" {
  provider             = google-nightly
  location             = "global"
  flag_attribute_id    = "variants-user-attr"
  key                  = "variants_user_id"
  attribute_value_type = "FLAG_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_TYPE_STRING"
}

resource "google_saas_runtime_flag" "integer_flag" {
  provider        = google-nightly
  location        = "global"
  flag_id         = "example-int-flag"
  key             = "example-int-flag-key"
  flag_value_type = "FLAG_VALUE_TYPE_INTEGER"
  unit_kind       = google_saas_runtime_unit_kind.example_unit_kind.id

  variants {
    id            = "zero"
    integer_value = 0
  }

  variants {
    id            = "max-retries"
    integer_value = 5
  }

  evaluation_spec {
    default_variant = "zero"

resource "google_saas_runtime_flag" "string_flag" {
  provider        = google-nightly
  location        = "global"
  flag_id         = "example-string-flag"

  variants {
    id           = "empty"
    string_value = ""

  variants {
    id           = "v2"

}

resource "google_saas_runtime_flag" "double_flag" {
  provider        = google-nightly
  location        = "global"
  flag_id         = "example-double-flag"
  key             = "example-double-flag-key"
  flag_value_type = "FLAG_VALUE_TYPE_DOUBLE"
  unit_kind       = google_saas_runtime_unit_kind.example_unit_kind.id

  variants {
    id           = "none"
    double_value = 0
  }

  variants {
    id           = "half"
    double_value = 0.5
  }

  evaluation_spec {
    default_variant = "half"
  }
}

resource "google_saas_runtime_flag" "example" {
  provider        = google-nightly
  location        = "global"
  flag_id         = "example-dynamic-flag"
  key             = "example-dynamic-flag-key"
  flag_value_type = "FLAG_VALUE_TYPE_BOOLEAN"
  unit_kind       = google_saas_runtime_unit_kind.example_unit_kind.id

  variants {
    id            = "off"
    boolean_value = false
  }

  variants {
    id            = "on"
    boolean_value = true
  }

  evaluation_spec {
    attributes = [
      google_saas_runtime_flag_attribute.user_attribute.id,
    ]
    default_dynamic_allocation = "progressive-rollout"

    dynamic_allocations {
      id              = "progressive-rollout"
      randomized_on   = google_saas_runtime_flag_attribute.user_attribute.key
      initial_variant = "off"
      final_variant   = "on"
    }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `evaluation_spec` -
  (Required)
  Specification of how the flag value should be evaluated.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_spec).

* `flag_value_type` -
  (Required)
  Flag value type.
  Possible values:
  FLAG_VALUE_TYPE_BOOLEAN
  FLAG_VALUE_TYPE_INTEGER
  FLAG_VALUE_TYPE_STRING
  FLAG_VALUE_TYPE_DOUBLE

* `key` -
  (Required)
  Flag key used in runtime evaluation APIs (OpenFeature).
  Max length: 256 bytes.

* `unit_kind` -
  (Required)
  UnitKind that can consume this flag.

* `variants` -
  (Required)
  A list of variants.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_variants).

* `location` -
  (Required)
  Resource ID segment making up resource `name`. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.

* `flag_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID value for the new flag.


* `annotations` -
  (Optional)
  Annotations is an unstructured key-value map stored with a resource that
  may be set by external tools to store and retrieve arbitrary metadata.
  They are not queryable and should be preserved when modifying objects.
  More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/user-guide/annotations
  **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the annotations present in your configuration.
  Please refer to the field `effective_annotations` for all of the annotations present on the resource.

* `description` -
  (Optional)
  Description of the flag. Max length: 500 bytes.

* `flag_set` -
  (Optional)
  Flag set this flag belongs to.

* `labels` -
  (Optional)
  The labels on the resource, which can be used for categorization.
  similar to Kubernetes resource labels.
  **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
  Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.

* `state` -
  (Optional)
  Current state of the flag.
  Possible values:
  FLAG_STATE_IN_DEVELOPMENT
  FLAG_STATE_ACTIVE
  FLAG_STATE_SUNSETTING
  FLAG_STATE_CLEANUP

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_evaluation_spec"></a>The `evaluation_spec` block supports:

* `allocations` -
  (Optional)
  A list of allocations.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_spec_allocations).

* `attributes` -
  (Optional)
  Names of the context attributes that are used in the evaluation rules and
  allocations.

* `default_allocation` -
  (Optional)
  The ID of an allocation to use as the default.

* `default_dynamic_allocation` -
  (Optional)
  The ID of a dynamic allocation to use as the default.

* `default_variant` -
  (Optional)
  The name of a variant to use as the default.

* `dynamic_allocations` -
  (Optional)
  A list of dynamic allocations.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_spec_dynamic_allocations).

* `rules` -
  (Optional)
  Evaluation rules define the logic for evaluating the flag against a given
  context. The rules are evaluated sequentially in their specified order.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_spec_rules).


<a name="nested_evaluation_spec_allocations"></a>The `allocations` block supports:

* `description` -
  (Optional)
  Description of the allocation. Max length: 500 bytes.

* `id` -
  (Required)
  Allocation ID. Max length: 128 bytes.

* `randomized_on` -
  (Required)
  Key of the context attribute that is used for traffic splitting.

* `slots` -
  (Required)
  Slots defines the weighted distribution of variants.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_spec_allocations_slots).


<a name="nested_evaluation_spec_allocations_slots"></a>The `slots` block supports:

* `variant` -
  (Required)
  Variant of the allocation slot.

* `weight` -
  (Required)
  Weight defines the proportion of traffic to allocate to the variant,
  relative to other slots in the same allocation.

<a name="nested_evaluation_spec_dynamic_allocations"></a>The `dynamic_allocations` block supports:

* `description` -
  (Optional)
  Description of the dynamic allocation. Max length: 500 bytes.

* `final_variant` -
  (Required)
  The name of the target variant of the launch - the one that sits at
  100%.

* `id` -
  (Required)
  Allocation ID. Max length: 128 bytes.

* `initial_variant` -
  (Required)
  The name of the "starting" variant during the launch - the one at 0%.

* `randomized_on` -
  (Required)
  The attribute used for randomization.

* `salt` -
  (Optional)
  Salt for the dynamic allocation. By default, a user does not need to
  provide a salt; the system uses a default salt when evaluating the
  dynamic allocation if omitted.

<a name="nested_evaluation_spec_rules"></a>The `rules` block supports:

* `allocation_id` -
  (Optional)
  The ID of an allocation to target.

* `condition` -
  (Required)
  A Common Expression Language (CEL) expression that evaluates to a
  boolean. The expression is evaluated against the provided context. If it
  returns true, the rule's target is applied.

* `dynamic_allocation_id` -
  (Optional)
  The ID of a dynamic allocation to target.

* `id` -
  (Required)
  Evaluation rule ID. Max length: 128 bytes.

* `variant_id` -
  (Optional)
  The name of a variant to target.

<a name="nested_variants"></a>The `variants` block supports:

* `boolean_value` -
  (Optional)
  Boolean variant value.

* `description` -
  (Optional)
  A human-readable description of what this variant does or represents.

* `double_value` -
  (Optional)
  Double variant value.

* `id` -
  (Required)
  Variant ID. Max length: 128 bytes.

* `integer_value` -
  (Optional)
  Integer variant value.

* `string_value` -
  (Optional)
  String variant value.

* `tracking_id` -
  (Output)
  trackingId is unique depending on name and value of the variant within
  the scope of the service. It is typically generated by the server and
  must not be changed. trackingId is used to uniquely identify and track
  variants.

* `name` -
  Identifier. The resource name (full URI of the resource) following the standard naming

* `uid` -
  The unique identifier of the resource. UID is unique in the time
  and space for this resource within the scope of the service. It is
  typically generated by the server on successful creation of a resource
  and must not be changed. UID is used to uniquely identify resources
  with resource name reuses. This should be a UUID4.

* `update_time` -
  The timestamp when the resource was last updated. Any
  change to the resource made by users must refresh this value.
  Changes to a resource made by the service should refresh this value.

* `effective_annotations` -
  All of annotations (key/value pairs) present on the resource in GCP, including the annotations configured through Terraform, other clients and services.

* `terraform_labels` -
  The combination of labels configured directly on the resource
   and default labels configured on the provider.

* `effective_labels` -
  All of labels (key/value pairs) present on the resource in GCP, including the labels configured through Terraform, other clients and services.

## Import


Flag can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/flags/{{flag_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{flag_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{flag_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import Flag using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-required value->"
    flagId = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_saas_runtime_flag.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import Flag using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/flags/{{flag_id}}"
  to = google_saas_runtime_flag.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), Flag can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_saas_runtime_flag.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/flags/{{flag_id}}
$ terraform import google_saas_runtime_flag.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{flag_id}}
$ terraform import google_saas_runtime_flag.default {{location}}/{{flag_id}}
```
